[SWS_DM_00901] Possible failure of ClearDTC
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04194
⌈
If the function
ara::diag::DTCInformation::Clear
is called and the clear op-
eration fails due to the reasons according to [SWS_DM_00122], the DM shall trigger
the error
kFailed
.
⌋
7.3.4.4.6
Aging
A stored DTC can age in terms of reaching a
DiagnosticAging.threshold
value
of passed
operation cycles
, specified by the vendor, where no failed tests have
been reported by a monitoring application. The amount of
operation cycles
,
where these non-failed reports occur is called the
Aging
counter. After the thresh-
old is reached, the DTC is cleared from the
event memory
.
